project.title: Exchange Email Cloud Migration

parentsummary.deliverables: Delivered the full Office 365 Exchange migration for HighRoads US Boston operations, encompassing Active Directory reconfiguration, tenant creation, Exchange mailbox and resource cutover, PowerShell scripting, HIPAA and NIST-aligned access control establishment, and legacy Exchange decommission to support the organization's post-restructuring cloud strategy.
parentsummary.outcomes: Successfully migrated HighRoads US email infrastructure to Office 365, consolidating communications onto a cloud platform, establishing compliant access controls aligned to ISO:27001, NIST, and HIPAA, and enabling the organization to reduce on-premises IT overhead.

challenge.summary: HighRoads US required a full Exchange to Office 365 mailbox migration to be completed within a compressed three-month window under HIPAA, NIST, and ISO:27001 compliance requirements, with Active Directory reconfiguration required before mailbox cutover could proceed.

deliverables: Migration planning and aligning to tool requirements
Office365 Tenant Creation and Domain planning
Exchange Mailbox & Resource Migration & Cutover Process
Facilitated requirements gathering with client teams from multiple sites
Implementation of IT Security and Cyber Protection Controls. Map to ISO:27001, NIST, and HIPAA
Established the Office 365 access control framework for the HighRoads US migration
Migration Review and end user documentation
Provide documentation, knowledge transfer, and cross-training

outcomes: Migrated HighRoads US email infrastructure to Office 365, consolidating all corporate mailboxes and resources onto a cloud-hosted platform within the three-month engagement window
Established access control framework aligned to HIPAA, NIST, and ISO:27001 standards, replacing uncontrolled on-premises permission models
Decommissioned on-premises Exchange Server services, eliminating associated infrastructure operating costs
